_doc: US cosmetic profile for scripts/check_copy.py, built on amazon-standard. Draft, unverified; awaiting human category compliance review and label verification before publication.

Cosmetic intake permits sourced scalp-care, appearance and practical benefits, verified directions and product facts, and sourced ingredient facts. An ingredient fact must not imply a finished-product result. Every such line needs its source in claims.md and meaning-level facts-and-images review; regex checks cannot establish substantiation or image implications.

Disease and body-structure/function claims are outside this cosmetic-only tier. Drug or device intended use needs separate category review, not a facts.allow exemption. These patterns are a first filter, not a complete legal word list.

Agency restrictions: detox/timing promises and device-mechanism copy are held out of this tier. Quality, origin, testing and free-from copy needs an evidence-backed exact-line brief approval and the existing facts.allow exemption. Those agency holds are not claims that FDA bans every matching word. Use, amounts and units must match the label.

Source-required warnings: appearance, safety and ingredient/mechanism wording is not blanket-banned. Record each matched line, source, intended cosmetic meaning and refuter resolution in claims.md before clearance. Hypoallergenic has no FDA definition or specific federal standard; our source/review requirement is an agency rule, not an FDA prohibition.

FDA intended-use distinction: https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetics-laws-regulations/it-cosmetic-drug-or-both-or-it-soap ; hypoallergenic: https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetics-labeling-claims/hypoallergenic-cosmetics . Checked 2026-11-12; profile remains unverified.
Inherited amazon-standard rules still apply. No supplement structure/function disclaimer is imposed on cosmetic facts.
